name: df
summary: Report file system disk space usage.
description: Display amount of available disk space taken up by file systems.

options.description: Print sizes in human readable format (e.g., 1K 234M 2G).
Print file system type for each partition.

examples.title: Check disk space
examples.output:
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda1        50G   20G   28G  42% /
tmpfs           3.9G     0  3.9G   0% /dev/shm
examples.explanation: Shows disk capacity, used space, and mount points in human-readable sizes.

useCases: Checking available storage space on partitions
